question: Who can buy an HDB flat under the couples and families routes described by HDB?
gold_answer: HDB's couples-and-families routes cover eligible family nuclei such as fiancé/fiancée couples, married couples and/or parents with children, and other family configurations described on the page. Eligibility still depends on conditions such as citizenship, flat type, property ownership and household status.
gold_evidence_summary: HDB couples/families page lists eligible family nuclei and separate eligibility conditions.

retrieved_chunks.title: Couples and Families
retrieved_chunks.text: A household’s eligibility for housing subsidies and HDB housing loan is assessed based on the core family nucleus, which is formed by the core member(s). Core members refer to the applicant(s) and occupier(s) in an HFE letter application who enable the household to qualify for a flat purchase under an eligibility scheme. All core members must remain in the flat application, and physically reside in the flat during the minimum occupation period (MOP) after the flat purchase. Their names cannot be removed. Your household must comprise 1 of the following groups: You, your spouse and child(ren) You, your parents and siblings. If you are an unmarried/ widowed/ divorced SC buying a flat with parents, at least one of your parents must be an SC or SPR. You and your child(ren) under your legal custody, care and control (for widowed/ divorced persons). If the care and control of your child is shared with your ex-spouse, you must obtain his/ her written agreement before you may list your child in a flat application. If you face difficulties in obtaining the agreement, please write to us to share your situation and your finalised divorce documents. You and your family may apply for a flat from HDB or buy a resale flat on the open market. If you intend to buy a 3Gen flat, refer to multi-generation families. If you are an unwed parent and would like to buy a flat with your child(ren), please write to us to share your situation. We will contact you and assess the request holistically.

question: Can a single person buy an HDB flat alone under HDB's singles route?
gold_answer: Yes. An eligible Singapore Citizen single can buy alone under HDB's singles route, generally from age 35. The flat types available depend on whether the purchase is a new or resale flat and on the applicable eligibility conditions.
gold_evidence_summary: HDB singles/EHG guidance identifies first-timer singles aged 35+ buying on their own among eligible household types.

question: If a user asks for the CPF OA interest rate for a period outside the effective dates in the current source, should the system reuse the current rate?
gold_answer: No. A CPF interest rate stated for one effective period should not be reused as the rate for a different period unless an authoritative source establishes that rate for the requested period. The system should qualify or abstain instead.
